title: This is the kind of AI assisted trading I actually like
author: disloyalorval2
selftext:
Model liked MSFT to the upside and the setup stayed valid long enough that I didnt have much reason to interfere.

Closed the position after about 7 hours 40 minutes for +$3.5k. Used Moon for the leveraged side and kept the wager at $750 because 1000x speaks for itself lol.

Much more comfortable with AI narrowing the field than blindly letting it press the button.

comments.author: UsefulTarget5709
comments.body: Seven hours and forty minutes without messing with it is way more impressive than the payout.

comments.author: Major-Tooth4793
comments.body: Also respect for actually stopping the wager at a size that made sense. A lot of people see 1000x and think the story is about maximizing upside, when really the only sane way to touch that kind of leverage is by controlling the dollar amount so tightly that the leverage itself does not dominate your decision making.
